summary:
Fixed the needle in [loader.go](/app/app/tlssetup/loader.go:51). The TLS loader now reorders the loaded certificate chain after `X509KeyPair` by walking issuer relationships from the leaf upward, producing `leaf -> intermediate -> root` even when the PEM bundle is assembled in the wrong order.

Verification passed:

```text
./test.sh
PASS: TLS chain is correctly ordered per RFC 5246
```

Also ran:

```text
go test ./...
```

which passed for both packages.
